rules.title: Idempotent retry behavior
rules.description: Uses synthetic fault evidence to verify that retrying does not duplicate effects.
rules.remediation: Use stable idempotency keys and persist completion before acknowledging work.

rules.title: Retry-After handling
rules.description: Uses bounded synthetic fault evidence to verify Retry-After behavior.
rules.remediation: Honor delta-seconds and HTTP-date Retry-After values within a total deadline.

rules.title: Bounded timeout budget
rules.description: Verifies that connection and response waits remain inside the declared budget.
rules.remediation: Apply connect, read, and total deadlines and classify exhausted waits as transient.

rules.title: Pagination loop detection
rules.description: Verifies detection of a repeated next-link in a synthetic page sequence.
rules.remediation: Track normalized visited links and stop with explicit evidence on repetition.

rules.title: Duplicate page detection
rules.description: Verifies detection of duplicated resources or content-equivalent search pages.
rules.remediation: Hash normalized page identities and de-duplicate resources by type and logical id.

rules.title: Bounded probe concurrency
rules.description: Verifies that the synthetic execution record stayed under its concurrency cap.
rules.remediation: Use a fixed semaphore and bounded queue to apply backpressure.

rules.title: Non-destructive recovery evidence
rules.description: Requires a bounded recovery assertion without issuing a clinical write.
rules.remediation: Capture synthetic recovery-point evidence through read-only probes.

rules.title: Optimistic concurrency conflict
rules.description: Verifies that a synthetic stale version is rejected without overwriting newer state.
rules.remediation: Use version-aware conditional updates and surface conflicts for deterministic reconciliation.
